 Follow Malin Akerman & Brittany Snow Promise a ‘Steamier’ Hunting Wives Season 2
 Isha Sharma Fri, November 13, 2026 at 10:10 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Netflix Malin Akerman and Brittany Snow are teasing more intense and steamy moments in The Hunting Wives Season 2 . The actresses will reprise their roles as Margo Banks and Sophie O'Neil in the Netflix thriller. They have also shared a few details about the upcoming installment, hinting that the new episodes will turn up the heat even further.
 In an interview with Entertainment Tonight , Snow described the new season as "a little steamier." Akerman agreed with her co-star, adding that other cast members would also bring more heat to the new season. She said, "Well, definitely it's a bit steamier, not only from us, but from more cast members as well." Snow kept the details under wraps, adding, "We'll leave you with that."
 The actresses also spoke about the friendship they formed through the series. Akerman revealed that working together had brought them closer off-screen.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She said, "We couldn't be happier to have this new friendship off-screen." Akerman added that building close friendships later in life is not very common and described them as lucky to have found each other. Snow shared her excitement about continuing their time together, saying, "We can't hang out more, which is great."
 The Hunting Wives Season 2 brings back familiar faces with more drama ahead
 The second season will continue the story of Sophie and Margo following the events of the first installment. The two women will initially be on bad terms, but old secrets and new enemies will bring them back together. Their complicated relationship will once again take center stage as they become involved in more dangerous situations.
 Alongside Akerman and Snow, several familiar cast members will return for Season 2. They include Dermot Mulroney as Jed Banks, Jaime Ray Newman as Callie Baskin, Evan Jonigkeit as Graham O'Neil, George Ferrier as Brad Thompson, Karen Rodriguez as Deputy Wanda Salazar, and Hunter Emery as Deputy Walter Flynn.
 The new season will also introduce several newcomers, including John Stamos , Kim Matula, Cam Gigandet, Alex FitzAlan, Dale Dickey, and WNBA star Angel Reese.
 Advertisement Advertisement All eight episodes of The Hunting Wives Season 2 will premiere on Netflix on November 26, 2026. The series has also received an early renewal for Season 3.
